description: REQUIRES AN API KEY (free: up to 5 items per call, pro 200, team 2000; sign up at https://mdexa.com/signup/). Check names, slugs or URLs of datasets and models against the Mdexa database in one call: per item the compact row and the match basis, or not_in_catalog / ambiguous; registered entries come back as unverified_registered with no conclusion. Never guesses: unmatched means not listed. report = a markdown, json or html report instead of rows. A list longer than the plan's items per call is not refused: the first items are checked (real rows) and the answer carries not_checked (count, items: what was not done) and locked (your cap, the plan that checks longer lists and its cap): tell the user both; one call still counts once. A report is refused whole when the list is over the cap.

items.description: Names, slugs, aliases or source URLs (mixed is fine).

name: batch_check
title: Check a list of datasets
